description: Forced-heirship / testamentary-freedom position for a jurisdiction: whether forced heirship exists, the reserved shares (e.g. France réserve héréditaire, Germany Pflichtteil, Switzerland reform), the freely-disposable portion, whether a spouse/children can be disinherited, and how trusts/foundations interact with reserved shares. States the default legal rules — NOT how any estate will devolve. Use ISO alpha-2.
